pr_title: locale: Support setting locale on Windows
pr_body:
Signed-off-by: Kapil Chouhan <kapil.chouhan@msystechnologies.com>

## Description
- Now users can set the system locale on Windows with the help of locale resource.
- Added test cases
- Ensured chef-style on the code changes made

## Related Issue
Fixes: #9450

pr_comments: Also make a point this only support language part for Windows and not lc_env so this will require document update.

So what you really want is something more like the windows_firewall resource:

https://github.com/chef/chef/blob/master/lib/chef/resource/windows_firewall_rule.rb

You'll want to get the lang resource for current_resource by powershelling out on windows or parsing the file on Linux. Then you can just use converge_if_changed(:lang) like is done in windows_firewall. That avoids a lot of the per platform logic here and is the correct way to load state and then change a system if the state doesn't match the desired state.

issue_context.title: Update the locale resource to support Windows
issue_context.body:
### Describe the Enhancement:
Update the locale resource to support Windows by using Get-WinSystemLocale and Set-WinSystemLocale.

### Describe the Need:
This is something people would want to configure on Windows and we can add it with minimal effort.

### Current Alternative
powershell_script can be used right now.
